policy.unsafe: Every production unsafe block or impl requires an adjacent // SAFETY: comment; protocol unsafe identities may not grow.
policy.safe_raw_pointer_api: Public safe functions must not accept raw pointers.
policy.debt: Existing panic surfaces, manual Pin projection, protocol unsafe regions, and mod.rs files may be deleted but not added.
policy.legacy_runtime: Non-canonical production RocketMQRuntime use is forbidden.
policy.typed_filter: Deprecated Filter::compile and local FilterError diagnostics are compiler-resolved; only exact baseline-recorded occurrences in canonical compatibility owners are retained.
